goal: Keep state durable and scoped while reducing repeated work without hiding cost or stale data.
acceptance: Cache entries cannot cross owner/company/model/source revisions.
Concurrent admission is atomic and retains unresolved reservations.
Migration evidence distinguishes offline consistency from a real database run; indexes match actual query shapes.
prompt: Audit the supplied query and cache path. Propose the smallest index or invalidation change, prove tenant/version isolation with a fixture, and label any unmeasured performance expectation.
